description: Saves a supplied self-contained HTML game as a free private draft. Returns a preview URL and private management token. Accepted games have inline code and embedded assets, keyboard and touch controls, a goal and restart. Network requests, payments and personal-data collection are prohibited. Repeated requests with the same idempotency key return the existing draft.

html.description: Complete self-contained HTML game with inline CSS/JS and embedded assets. External dependencies, fetches, forms, popups, payments and personal-data collection are prohibited. Supported controls are canvas or DOM with keyboard and touch input. The game includes restart and clear win/lose states. Completion notification is parent.postMessage({type:'playablegift:complete'}, '*').

name: create_custom_game
title: Save a custom game
